## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).

- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

17

143	### 4.2 CopyOp：把一条拷贝写成十个整数
144	
145	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
146	
147	`CopyOp` 是整个项目的原子操作：**一条从本 rank 输入张量到某个 peer 对称窗口的步长拷贝**。它只有十个整数，没有指针——偏移都是**相对各自缓冲区基址的字节数**。这个设计带来一个关键好处（头文件注释原话）：**同一个结构既描述一条 `cudaMemcpy2D/3DAsync`，也描述测试里的一次主机重放**——设备路径和 numpy 重放路径执行的是同一份算术，所以无 GPU 的测试能证明布局正确。
148	
149	`depth` / `src_slice` / `dst_slice` 三个字段是「批维度折叠」：\( b \) 次相同的 rows×width 拷贝、按固定步长排布，可以合成**一次** 3D 拷贝。
150	
151	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
152	
153	字段 → CUDA memcpy 参数的映射表（对照 [src/transfer.cu:L26-L52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L26-L52) 的 `issue_copy`）：
154	
155	| CopyOp 字段 | 含义 | `cudaMemcpy2DAsync` | `cudaMemcpy3DAsync` |
156	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
157	| `peer` | 发给哪个 rank | 决定目的基址 `peer_ptrs[p]` | 同左 |
158	| `src_offset` | 源基址偏移（字节） | 调用方加到 src 上 | 同左 |
159	| `dst_offset` | 目的基址偏移（字节） | 调用方加到 dst 上 | 同左 |
160	| `src_pitch` | 源相邻行间距 | `spitch` 参数 | `srcPtr.pitch` |
161	| `dst_pitch` | 目的相邻行间距 | `dpitch` 参数 | `dstPtr.pitch` |
162	| `width` | 每行字节数 | `width` 参数 | `extent.width` |
163	| `rows` | 行数 | `height` 参数 | `extent.height` |
164	| `depth` | 折叠的批元素个数 | （不出现，=1 走 2D） | `extent.depth` |
165	| `src_slice` / `dst_slice` | 批元素间距 | （不出现） | 推导 `xsize`：`slice / pitch` |
166	
167	注意基址相加发生在**发射时**（[src/transfer.cu:L92](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L92)）：`peer_ptrs[p] + op.dst_offset`、`src_bytes + op.src_offset`——CopyOp 自己永远只存相对偏移。
168	
169	mode 0（scatter head）下，本 rank \( r \) 发给 peer \( p \) 的拷贝参数由这组公式给出（记 \( e \) 为 `elem_size`，\( d_b = d \cdot e \) 为每头字节数，\( N \) 为 `head_total`，\( S_r \) 为 `seq_offset[r]`，\( s_r \) 为 `seq_splits[r]`）：
170	
171	\[ \text{row}_p = h_p \cdot d_b \]
172	\[ \text{src\_offset} = H_p \cdot d_b, \qquad \text{src\_pitch} = N \cdot d_b \]
173	\[ \text{dst\_offset} = S_r \cdot \text{row}_p, \qquad \text{dst\_pitch} = \text{width} = \text{row}_p, \qquad \text{rows} = s_r \]
174	
175	直觉：输入张量里「peer \( p \) 的头列」每隔 \( N \cdot d_b \) 字节出现一段 \( h_p \cdot d_b \) 字节（**读跨步**）；而 \( p \) 的窗口里序列维是连续的，本 rank 的贡献恰好落在自己序列分片占的那几行（**写连续**）。批间距：源侧一个批元素整张 \( s_r \cdot N \cdot d_b \)，目的侧一整窗 \( \text{seq\_total} \cdot \text{row}_p \)。
176	
177	批折叠的判定条件（`push_batched`）：
178	
179	\[ \text{worth\_fusing} \iff \text{depth} > 1 \,\wedge\, \text{rows} > 1 \]
180	\[ \text{expressible} \iff \text{src\_slice} \bmod \text{src\_pitch} = 0 \,\wedge\, \text{dst\_slice} \bmod \text{dst\_pitch} = 0 \,\wedge\, \frac{\text{src\_slice}}{\text{src\_pitch}} \ge \text{rows} \,\wedge\, \frac{\text{dst\_slice}}{\text{dst\_pitch}} \ge \text{rows} \]

239	### 4.3 A2APlan：输出形状、窗口尺寸与发送清单
240	
241	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
242	
243	`A2APlan` 是 `build_plan` 的返回值，三个字段回答三个问题：
244	
245	1. `output_shape`——**本 rank** 收到的输出长什么样（从窗口基址起是稠密的）。
246	2. `window_numel`——对称窗口必须装下多少元素。关键：这是**全组最大**那个 rank 的输出量，不是本 rank 的。
247	3. `ops`——本 rank 要**发**的拷贝清单，`ops[i].peer` 说明每条发去哪。
248	
249	`window_numel` 取最大值的原因有两层（头文件注释给出）：**peer 的写入偏移只有当每个 rank 分配同样大小的窗口时才能对齐**——本 rank 给 peer \( p \) 算的 `dst_offset` 是按「\( p \) 的窗口按统一布局排布」假设写的；同时，每个 rank **无需通信**就能算出这个最大值，因为切分表描述的是整个组。
250	
251	另一个关键设计：**本 rank 自己的份额也走窗口**（`ops` 覆盖全部 `world_size` 个目的地，包括 `peer == rank`）。这正是零拷贝路径需要的——窗口本身就是调用者的输出；也让 copying 路径的 copy-out 成为一次平坦拷贝（整窗一起搬出），见 [include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp:L62-L64](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp#L62-L64) 的注释。
252	
253	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
254	
255	```
256	build_plan(dims, mode, elem_size):
257	  1. dims.validate(); elem_size、mode 合法性检查
258	  2. 算 seq_total / head_total / 两组 offsets / s_me / n_me
259	  3. check_byte_products —— 给所有字节量一个总上界（见 4.4）
260	  4. output_shape:
261	       mode 0 -> (b, seq_total, n_me, d)
262	       mode 1 -> (b, s_me, head_total, d)
263	  5. window_numel = max over p of  b * rows(p) * heads(p) * d
264	       mode 0: rows(p) = seq_total, heads(p) = head_splits[p]
265	       mode 1: rows(p) = seq_splits[p],  heads(p) = head_total
266	     （每次乘法都过 checked_mul）
267	  6. 对每个 peer p 发射一条 CopyOp（公式见 4.2；mode 1 是镜像：
268	     读连续、写跨步，因为窗口就是返回张量，没有本地整理的机会）
269	```
270	
271	mode 0 的窗口尺寸公式：
272	
273	\[ \text{window\_numel} = \max_p \; b \cdot \text{seq\_total} \cdot h_p \cdot d \]

317	**练习 2**：mode 1 下 `window_numel` 的公式是什么？用同一组 splits 算一遍。
318	
319	**答案**：mode 1 下每个 rank 接收 `(b, s_p, head_total, d)`，所以 \[ \text{window\_numel} = \max_p \; b \cdot s_p \cdot \text{head\_total} \cdot d = 2 \times 8 \times 8 \times \max_p s_p = 128 \times 7 = 896 \]。注意两个 mode 的窗口大小**不相等**（720 vs 896），但同一 mode 内全组一致——u4-l2 会讲到窗口按角色缓存，sync 路径里两个 mode 各自触发自己的增长。
320	
321	**练习 3**：为什么说「本 rank 份额也走窗口」让 copy-out 变成一次平坦拷贝？
322	
323	**答案**：所有发送方（包括本 rank 自己）都把数据写进窗口的稠密前缀，窗口内容从基址起就是完整的输出张量字节。copy-out 因此不需要任何重排，只需把整段字节从窗口搬进调用者的输出张量——一次 `cudaMemcpyAsync`。若自己的份额直接留在输入里，copy-out 就得处理「一部分在窗口、一部分在本地」的拼接。
324	
325	---
326	
327	### 4.4 validate 与溢出防护：先于一切分配的防御
328	
329	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
330	
331	`build_plan` 的开头是三道闸门：`dims.validate()`、`elem_size` 检查、`mode` 检查（[src/a2a_plan.cc:L143-L151](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L143-L151)）。纪律是：**校验必须先于任何分配**（头文件注释：Call before anything allocates）。这与 u2-l2 讲过的「全部校验先于第一个屏障」一脉相承——被拒的参数不该留下任何副作用。
332	
333	溢出防护是本模块的主角。要害在于：上层入口 `make_dims`（src/group.cc，u2-l3 讲过）只拿**本 rank 的张量**和 splits 交叉校验，**peer 的表项不受任何张量约束**。如果 `seq_splits = [1, 2^62]`，`window_numel` 的乘积会溢出 int64——注释原话：**一个回绕的乘积给出负的 window_numel，而每个下游尺寸检查都会把它读成「够小」**。防护分三层：
334	
335	1. `checked_mul(a, b)`：乘之前检查 \( b > \lfloor \text{max}/a \rfloor \)。
336	2. `checked_sum(values)`：累加时检查运行和。
337	3. `check_byte_products`：给**所有字节量**（offset、pitch、width、slice 都是五个因子的部分乘积）一个总上界——因为 window_numel 按元素计，管不住按字节计的量；而有符号溢出是 UB，连「变成负数被下游抓住」都不可指望。
338	
339	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
340	
341	```
342	validate():
343	  world_size > 0
344	  0 <= rank < world_size
345	  b > 0 且 d > 0
346	  len(seq_splits)  == world_size
347	  len(head_splits) == world_size
348	  每个表项 >= 0      （== 0 合法：零分片；< 0 拒绝）
349	  任一失败 -> throw std::invalid_argument("fast_ulysses: <指名字段的问题>")
350	
351	checked_mul(a, b):
352	  若 a != 0 且 b > INT64_MAX / a -> fail（"overflows int64"）
353	  否则返回 a * b
354	
355	check_byte_products(dims, seq_total, head_total, elem_size):
356	  bound = ∏ max(factor, 1)  for factor in {b, seq_total, head_total, d, elem_size}
357	  每步乘法走 checked_mul          （空轴按 1 计：它只是让拷贝不发射，不会让别的因子变小）
358	```
359	
360	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
361	
362	- [src/a2a_plan.cc:L113-L141](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L113-L141)：`validate` 全文。六组检查、每条消息指名字段与实际值（例如 `seq_splits has 2 entries, expected 4`）；L132 的注释划清边界——零分片合法、负数不合法。
363	- [src/a2a_plan.cc:L19-L25](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L19-L25)：`checked_mul`。注意 `a != 0` 守卫避免除零；注释解释为什么必须有它（peer 表项无界 → 乘积回绕 → 负 window_numel 被下游当「够小」）。
364	- [src/a2a_plan.cc:L27-L37](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L27-L37)：`checked_sum`——对每个元素检查 `v > max - total` 再累加，防求和本身溢出。
365	- [src/a2a_plan.cc:L39-L50](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L39-L50)：`check_byte_products`。注释（L39-L43）给出三点理由：window_numel 按元素计、字节量是五个因子的部分乘积所以一个上界全覆盖、有符号溢出是 UB 而非「可被后续检查抓住的负数」；空轴按 1 计。
366	- [src/a2a_plan.cc:L159](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L159)：`check_byte_products` 在 `build_plan` 里的调用位置——在窗口循环和发射循环**之前**，即任何字节量被算出来之前。
367	- [test/test_plan.py:L317-L333](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/test_plan.py#L317-L333)：溢出用例与**负控制**注释——测试文件明确写着：把 `checked_mul`/`checked_sum` 拆掉重编译，这两个用例就会「成功」返回一个带负 window_numel 的计划而不是抛异常。负控制的存在说明作者知道这类检查最容易被「顺手简化」掉。
368	
369	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
370	
371	**目标**：亲手触发两类溢出，并对照负控制注释理解「如果不检查会怎样」。
372	
373	**步骤**：
374	
375	```python
376	# 示例代码：overflow_check.py
377	import torch, fast_ulysses
378	op = torch.ops.fast_ulysses.a2a_plan_debug
379	
380	cases = [
381	    ([1, 2**62], [1, 1], "乘积溢出：b*seq_total*heads*d*e 超过 int64"),
382	    ([2**62, 2**62], [1, 1], "求和溢出：seq_total 本身就超过 int64"),
383	]
384	for seq, head, why in cases:
385	    try:
386	        op(1, 8, 0, 2, seq, head, 0, 2)
387	        print("NOT REJECTED!", why)
388	    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 —— 与 test/test_plan.py 的捕获方式一致
389	        print("OK ->", e, "   #", why)
390	```
391	
392	**需要观察的现象**：两条都被拒，消息都含 `overflows int64`。第一条实际由 `check_byte_products` 触发（消息形如 `the exchange in bytes overflows int64 (...)`，它先于窗口循环执行）；第二条由 `checked_sum`（经 `seq_total()`）触发（消息形如 `seq_splits total overflows int64`）。
393	
394	**预期结果**：与 [test/test_plan.py:L324-L333](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/test_plan.py#L324-L333) 的断言一致（`match="overflows int64"`）。实际运行输出待本地验证。
395	
396	然后做一个**思想实验**（对应负控制）：如果把 `checked_mul` 换成裸的 `*`，第一个用例里 \( 1 \times (1 + 2^{62}) \times 1 \times 8 \times 2 \) 回绕后的值按补码可能得到负数，而窗口分配处的 `if (need > window.numel())` 之类的比较会把负数当「够小」放行——于是得到一个远小于所需的窗口。写出这条因果链（三行以内）即可。
397	
398	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
399	
400	**练习 1**：`validate` 为什么允许 `seq_splits` 里出现 0，却不允许负数？
401	
402	**答案**：0 是真实会发生的几何——不均分时某个 rank 可能恰好分不到序列（[test/test_plan.py:L179-L181](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/test_plan.py#L179-L181) 的 `test_empty_shard` 专门覆盖 `[3,0,5,4]`），此时该 rank 只是不发射拷贝；负数没有任何合法语义，且会让前缀和产生重叠区间，所以直接拒绝（[src/a2a_plan.cc:L132-L140](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L132-L140)）。
403	
404	**练习 2**：`check_byte_products` 为什么把空轴按 1 计，而不是跳过？
405	
406	**答案**：一个为 0 的轴（比如 `b == 0`）确实让拷贝不再发射，但它**不会让其他因子变小**——发射公式里剩下的因子（seq_total、head_total、d、elem_size）的乘积仍然会被算出来。若按 0 跳过，上界就漏掉了这些量。按 1 计让上界覆盖「即使什么都没发，中间乘积也可能溢出」的情形（[src/a2a_plan.cc:L42-L43](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L42-L43) 注释）。
407	
408	**练习 3**：为什么 `checked_mul` 的条件是 `a != 0 && b > max / a`，而不是写完乘法再检查结果为负？
409	
410	**答案**：两个原因。其一，有符号溢出在 C++ 里是 UB——写完再查根本不保证能观察到「负数」，编译器可以假设溢出不发生而删掉检查。其二，正溢出的结果未必是负数（可能回绕成小正数），事后检查连「恰好变小的窗口」都抓不住。事前用整数除法比较是唯一可靠的做法；`a != 0` 守卫避免除零（[src/a2a_plan.cc:L19-L25](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L19-L25)）。
411	
412	## 5. 综合实践
413	
414	**任务**：完整执行本讲规格中的调试流程——用 `torch.ops.fast_ulysses.a2a_plan_debug` 打印 `ws=4`、`seq_splits=[5,3,0,7]` 下**每个 rank** 的 mode 0 ops 表，手工核对其中一行的全部字段，并**先预测再比对** `window_numel`。
415	
416	配置约定：`b=2, d=8, elem_size=2`（fp16），`head_splits=[3,2,2,1]`（刻意取不均匀，让窗口最大值落在 rank 0 而非「人人相等」）。

418	```python
419	# 示例代码：practice_u3l1.py —— 本实践不需要 GPU，只需已构建的 fast_ulysses 扩展
420	import torch
421	import fast_ulysses  # import 即注册 torch.ops.fast_ulysses（见 test_plan.py:19-21）
422	
423	WS, SEQ, HEAD = 4, [5, 3, 0, 7], [3, 2, 2, 1]
424	B, D, ELEM, MODE = 2, 8, 2, 0
425	COLS = ["peer", "src_off", "dst_off", "src_pitch", "dst_pitch",
426	        "width", "rows", "depth", "src_slice", "dst_slice"]
427	
428	# ---- 第 0 步：先在纸上预测（不许先跑代码） ----
429	# seq_offsets = [0,5,8,8], head_offsets = [0,3,5,7], seq_total=15, head_total=8, d_bytes=16
430	# window_numel = max_p 2*15*head[p]*8 = 240*3 = 720

432

434	for r in range(WS):
435	    shape, window, ops = torch.ops.fast_ulysses.a2a_plan_debug(

441	assert {p["window"] for p in plans} == {PREDICT_WINDOW}, "窗口预测失败"
442	print("window_numel 预测正确:", PREDICT_WINDOW)
443	
444	# ---- 第 2 步：手工核对 rank 1 -> peer 2 那一行 ----
445	# 公式（mode 0，r=1，p=2）：
446	#   row      = head[2]*d_bytes      = 2*16 = 32
447	#   src_off  = head_off[2]*d_bytes  = 5*16 = 80
448	#   src_pitch= head_total*d_bytes   = 8*16 = 128
449	#   dst_off  = seq_off[1]*row       = 5*32 = 160

472	
473	1. 在已安装 fast-ulysses（u1-l3）的环境里运行 `python practice_u3l1.py`。
474	2. 跑之前先把 `PREDICT_WINDOW` 和 `HAND` 两处换成**你自己**的手算结果，再让脚本判定。

476	
477	**预期结果**：三个断言全部通过；ops 表与第 3 步注释里的结构性预期一致。所有期望值均由 4.2/4.3 节的源码公式手算得出；实际运行输出待本地验证。
478	
479	**延伸思考**（为下一讲热身）：把 `MODE` 改成 1 再跑——你会看到同样的 splits 发射出的却是「读连续、写跨步」的镜像计划，且窗口变成 896。为什么两个 mode 用**同一对** splits 而不交换？带着这个问题进入 u3-l2。
480	
481	## 6. 本讲小结
482	
483	- `A2ADims` 把一次交换的全部几何（b、d、rank、world_size、两张切分表）装进纯主机结构；全 rank 持同一张表，前缀和免通信地给出全组偏移——这是「不均分是一般路径、偶均分是特例」的单一代码路径。
484	- `CopyOp` 用十个整数描述一条步长拷贝，偏移相对缓冲基址、无指针，因此同一结构既是 `cudaMemcpy2D/3DAsync` 的参数源，也是 numpy 重放的脚本——布局正确性可以脱离 GPU 验证。
485	- `depth`/`src_slice`/`dst_slice` 把批维度折叠成一条 3D 拷贝，但只对多行拷贝且步长可整除 pitch 时融合（`push_batched` 的两条判定）。
486	- `A2APlan` 的 `window_numel` 取全组最大接收量：peer 的写入偏移只有在所有 rank 分配同尺寸窗口时才对齐；每个 rank 凭全表无需通信即可算出同一个最大值。本 rank 自己的份额也走窗口，这让零拷贝路径成为可能、copy_out 成为一次平坦拷贝。
487	- `validate` 六组检查全部先于分配、指名字段报错；`checked_mul`/`checked_sum`/`check_byte_products` 三层防护拦住「peer 表项无界 → 乘积回绕 → 负窗口被下游当够小」这条路径，因为有符号溢出是 UB，事后检查不可靠。
488	
489	## 7. 下一步学习建议
490	
491	下一讲 **u3-l2（build_plan 精读：两种模式的拷贝发射）** 将把本讲 的字段公式扩展成完整的发射逻辑：mode 0 读跨步写连续、mode 1 读连续写跨步的镜像关系、「本 rank 份额也走窗口」这一决定在两条路径上分别兑现成什么，以及 `push_batched` 的融合判定在真实形状下的得与失。建议先完成本讲综合实践，并顺手把 `MODE` 改成 1 跑一遍，带着「同一对 splits 为什么不交换」的疑问去读。
492	
493	之后再进入 **u3-l3（无 GPU 的布局测试）**：看 `plan_bindings.cc` 如何把纯主机 plan 暴露成 `a2a_plan_debug` 算子、`test_plan.py` 如何用 numpy 字节缓冲重放 CopyOp 并对照 `all_to_all_single + permute` 的参照——你今天手算的每一条公式，那里都有可执行的断言。窗口如何被分配成真实显存，则要等 **u4-l1（torch 对称内存与窗口分配）**。

# A2ADims / CopyOp / A2APlan：寻址的纯主机表达

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 `A2ADims`、`CopyOp`、`A2APlan` 三个数据结构各自的职责，以及它们为什么能做到「无 CUDA、无 torch、无通信库」。
2. 把 `CopyOp` 的十个字段逐一映射到 `cudaMemcpy2DAsync` / `cudaMemcpy3DAsync` 的参数，理解「一条 4D all-to-all 的发送任务 = 一组带源/目的步长的字节拷贝」。
3. 解释 `window_numel` 为什么取**所有 rank 中最大**的接收量，而不是本 rank 自己的接收量。
4. 找出 `validate()` 与 `checked_mul` / `checked_sum` / `check_byte_products` 各自防住了哪一类非法输入，理解「先于一切分配做校验」与「符号溢出是未定义行为」这两条防御原则。

本讲是 u3 单元的第一讲：我们只看**寻址的纯主机表达**——数据长什么样、怎么算出来；下一讲（u3-l2）才深入 `build_plan` 两种模式的完整发射逻辑，u3-l3 再看无 GPU 的重放测试。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 步长拷贝（pitched copy）

普通 `memcpy` 只能搬运**一段连续**字节。如果要搬运的是二维「条纹」——每行取 `width` 字节、共 `rows` 行，但相邻行在内存里相隔 `pitch` 字节（中间夹着别人的数据）——就需要**步长拷贝**：

\[ \text{第 } i \text{ 行的目的起点} = \text{基址} + \text{offset} + i \times \text{pitch}, \quad i = 0, 1, \dots, \text{rows}-1 \]

CUDA 的 `cudaMemcpy2DAsync(dst, dpitch, src, spitch, width, height, ...)` 就是这个语义：源和目的各自有一个 pitch，每行搬 `width` 字节。理解了 pitched copy，本讲的 `CopyOp` 就只是一组整数。

### 2.2 前缀和（exclusive prefix sum）

给定每 rank 的分片长度表，比如 `seq_splits = [5, 3, 0, 7]`，**排他前缀和**给出每个 rank 的分片在全组总量里的起始偏移：

\[ \text{offset}_r = \sum_{k < r} \text{splits}[k] \]

即 `[0, 5, 8, 8]`。注意两个细节：不需要任何通信——每个 rank 手里都有**整张表**（u2-l3 讲过）；长度为 0 的分片（rank 2）会和它后面的 rank 共享同一个偏移（rank 2 和 rank 3 都从 8 开始）。

### 2.3 整数溢出与未定义行为

C++ 中**有符号整数溢出是未定义行为（UB）**：`a * b` 超过 \( 2^{63}-1 \) 时，编译器不需要给出任何特定结果，程序逻辑从此不可信。比「溢出后可能变成负数」更糟的是——它可能恰好变成一个**看起来合法的小正数**，绕过所有下游尺寸检查。所以本项目在算任何尺寸乘积之前先显式检查，宁可抛异常也不冒 UB 的险。

### 2.4 与前几讲的衔接

- u1-l4 已经建立分层地图：`a2a_plan.cc` 是**纯主机寻址层**，刻意不依赖 CUDA/torch/通信库，换来「无 GPU 也能测布局」与「Meta 内核复用」两个收益。
- u2-l2 讲过 `all_to_all_4d` 的形状契约：mode 0 把 `(b, s_local, n_global, d)` 变成 `(b, s_global, n_local, d)`，mode 1 是严格逆变换。
- u2-l3 讲过 `seq_splits` / `head_splits` 描述的是**组的切分几何**（每个 rank 的序列长与头数），全 rank 持有同一张表。

本讲回答的问题是：这份几何如何被翻译成一条条**具体到字节偏移**的拷贝指令。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 A2ADims：一次交换的全部几何

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`A2ADims` 回答一个问题：**这次 all-to-all 的「形状几何」是什么？** 它不看任何具体张量，只装七个数：批大小 `b`、头维 `d`、本 rank 编号、组大小，以及两张切分表。u2-l3 讲过切分表描述的是组几何而非单次收发量，所以 mode 0、mode 1、backward 共用同一份 `A2ADims`。

为什么要把几何单独抽成一个结构？因为寻址是**纯算术**：只要有了这张表，每个 rank 就能**免通信**地算出全组任何偏移——不需要 all_gather，不需要问任何 peer。这是整个「重排即步长」设计（u1-l1）的地基。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`A2ADims` 提供四个派生查询，全部是主机端纯函数：

```
seq_total()   = sum(seq_splits)              （带溢出检查）
head_total()  = sum(head_splits)             （带溢出检查）
seq_offsets() = 排他前缀和(seq_splits)
head_offsets()= 排他前缀和(head_splits)
validate()    = 抛 std::invalid_argument 指名道姓地报错
```

调用纪律写在头文件注释里：**在任何分配发生之前调用 `validate()`**。

### 4.2 CopyOp：把一条拷贝写成十个整数

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`CopyOp` 是整个项目的原子操作：**一条从本 rank 输入张量到某个 peer 对称窗口的步长拷贝**。它只有十个整数，没有指针——偏移都是**相对各自缓冲区基址的字节数**。这个设计带来一个关键好处（头文件注释原话）：**同一个结构既描述一条 `cudaMemcpy2D/3DAsync`，也描述测试里的一次主机重放**——设备路径和 numpy 重放路径执行的是同一份算术，所以无 GPU 的测试能证明布局正确。

`depth` / `src_slice` / `dst_slice` 三个字段是「批维度折叠」：\( b \) 次相同的 rows×width 拷贝、按固定步长排布，可以合成**一次** 3D 拷贝。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

字段 → CUDA memcpy 参数的映射表（对照 [src/transfer.cu:L26-L52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L26-L52) 的 `issue_copy`）：

| CopyOp 字段 | 含义 | `cudaMemcpy2DAsync` | `cudaMemcpy3DAsync` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `peer` | 发给哪个 rank | 决定目的基址 `peer_ptrs[p]` | 同左 |
| `src_offset` | 源基址偏移（字节） | 调用方加到 src 上 | 同左 |
| `dst_offset` | 目的基址偏移（字节） | 调用方加到 dst 上 | 同左 |
| `src_pitch` | 源相邻行间距 | `spitch` 参数 | `srcPtr.pitch` |
| `dst_pitch` | 目的相邻行间距 | `dpitch` 参数 | `dstPtr.pitch` |
| `width` | 每行字节数 | `width` 参数 | `extent.width` |
| `rows` | 行数 | `height` 参数 | `extent.height` |
| `depth` | 折叠的批元素个数 | （不出现，=1 走 2D） | `extent.depth` |
| `src_slice` / `dst_slice` | 批元素间距 | （不出现） | 推导 `xsize`：`slice / pitch` |

注意基址相加发生在**发射时**（[src/transfer.cu:L92](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L92)）：`peer_ptrs[p] + op.dst_offset`、`src_bytes + op.src_offset`——CopyOp 自己永远只存相对偏移。

mode 0（scatter head）下，本 rank \( r \) 发给 peer \( p \) 的拷贝参数由这组公式给出（记 \( e \) 为 `elem_size`，\( d_b = d \cdot e \) 为每头字节数，\( N \) 为 `head_total`，\( S_r \) 为 `seq_offset[r]`，\( s_r \) 为 `seq_splits[r]`）：

\[ \text{row}_p = h_p \cdot d_b \]
\[ \text{src\_offset} = H_p \cdot d_b, \qquad \text{src\_pitch} = N \cdot d_b \]
\[ \text{dst\_offset} = S_r \cdot \text{row}_p, \qquad \text{dst\_pitch} = \text{width} = \text{row}_p, \qquad \text{rows} = s_r \]

直觉：输入张量里「peer \( p \) 的头列」每隔 \( N \cdot d_b \) 字节出现一段 \( h_p \cdot d_b \) 字节（**读跨步**）；而 \( p \) 的窗口里序列维是连续的，本 rank 的贡献恰好落在自己序列分片占的那几行（**写连续**）。批间距：源侧一个批元素整张 \( s_r \cdot N \cdot d_b \)，目的侧一整窗 \( \text{seq\_total} \cdot \text{row}_p \)。

批折叠的判定条件（`push_batched`）：

\[ \text{worth\_fusing} \iff \text{depth} > 1 \,\wedge\, \text{rows} > 1 \]
\[ \text{expressible} \iff \text{src\_slice} \bmod \text{src\_pitch} = 0 \,\wedge\, \text{dst\_slice} \bmod \text{dst\_pitch} = 0 \,\wedge\, \frac{\text{src\_slice}}{\text{src\_pitch}} \ge \text{rows} \,\wedge\, \frac{\text{dst\_slice}}{\text{dst\_pitch}} \ge \text{rows} \]

**练习 1**：为什么 `push_batched` 拒绝融合单行（`rows == 1`）拷贝？

**答案**：单行拷贝本身就是一次平坦 memcpy（`width == pitch` 时 CE 直接线性搬）；折成 3D 拷贝反而把它推上跨步路径。而多行拷贝本来就在跨步路径上，融合省掉 \( b-1 \) 次发射是纯赚。见 [src/a2a_plan.cc:L66-L69](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L66-L69) 的注释，以及 [test/test_plan.py:L196-L203](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/test_plan.py#L196-L203) 的 `test_batch_fusion_rule`（`rows=1` 时断言每 peer 发 `b` 条独立 2D 拷贝）。

**练习 2**：`CopyOp` 里为什么没有指针、只有偏移？

**答案**：偏移相对「本 rank 输入张量基址」与「peer 窗口基址」。指针在发射时才由传输层加上（[src/transfer.cu:L92](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/transfer.cu#L92)），且 peer 窗口地址要靠对称内存 rendezvous 才知道（u4-l1）。保持无指针让同一份结构可以被 numpy 在字节缓冲上原样重放——这是布局能脱离 GPU 测试的前提。

### 4.3 A2APlan：输出形状、窗口尺寸与发送清单

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`A2APlan` 是 `build_plan` 的返回值，三个字段回答三个问题：

1. `output_shape`——**本 rank** 收到的输出长什么样（从窗口基址起是稠密的）。
2. `window_numel`——对称窗口必须装下多少元素。关键：这是**全组最大**那个 rank 的输出量，不是本 rank 的。
3. `ops`——本 rank 要**发**的拷贝清单，`ops[i].peer` 说明每条发去哪。

`window_numel` 取最大值的原因有两层（头文件注释给出）：**peer 的写入偏移只有当每个 rank 分配同样大小的窗口时才能对齐**——本 rank 给 peer \( p \) 算的 `dst_offset` 是按「\( p \) 的窗口按统一布局排布」假设写的；同时，每个 rank **无需通信**就能算出这个最大值，因为切分表描述的是整个组。

另一个关键设计：**本 rank 自己的份额也走窗口**（`ops` 覆盖全部 `world_size` 个目的地，包括 `peer == rank`）。这正是零拷贝路径需要的——窗口本身就是调用者的输出；也让 copying 路径的 copy-out 成为一次平坦拷贝（整窗一起搬出），见 [include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp:L62-L64](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/include/fast_ulysses/a2a_plan.hpp#L62-L64) 的注释。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```
build_plan(dims, mode, elem_size):
  1. dims.validate(); elem_size、mode 合法性检查
  2. 算 seq_total / head_total / 两组 offsets / s_me / n_me
  3. check_byte_products —— 给所有字节量一个总上界（见 4.4）
  4. output_shape:
       mode 0 -> (b, seq_total, n_me, d)
       mode 1 -> (b, s_me, head_total, d)
  5. window_numel = max over p of  b * rows(p) * heads(p) * d
       mode 0: rows(p) = seq_total, heads(p) = head_splits[p]
       mode 1: rows(p) = seq_splits[p],  heads(p) = head_total
     （每次乘法都过 checked_mul）
  6. 对每个 peer p 发射一条 CopyOp（公式见 4.2；mode 1 是镜像：
     读连续、写跨步，因为窗口就是返回张量，没有本地整理的机会）
```

mode 0 的窗口尺寸公式：

\[ \text{window\_numel} = \max_p \; b \cdot \text{seq\_total} \cdot h_p \cdot d \]

**练习 1**：如果 `window_numel` 取的是「本 rank 自己的输出量」而不是全组最大，会发生什么？

**答案**：不同 rank 会分配出**不同大小**的窗口，而本 rank 为 peer \( p \) 计算的 `dst_offset` 是按统一布局写的——比如 4.2 的例子里 rank 1 给 peer 0 写的偏移按「rank 0 的窗口能装下 720 个元素」假设，若 rank 0 只按自己的 480 分配（此例恰好相等，换一组 splits 就不等了），写入就会越界或错位。这正是测试断言「全组 window_numel 必须相同」的原因（[test/test_plan.py:L145-L146](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/test_plan.py#L145-L146)）。

**练习 2**：mode 1 下 `window_numel` 的公式是什么？用同一组 splits 算一遍。

**答案**：mode 1 下每个 rank 接收 `(b, s_p, head_total, d)`，所以 \[ \text{window\_numel} = \max_p \; b \cdot s_p \cdot \text{head\_total} \cdot d = 2 \times 8 \times 8 \times \max_p s_p = 128 \times 7 = 896 \]。注意两个 mode 的窗口大小**不相等**（720 vs 896），但同一 mode 内全组一致——u4-l2 会讲到窗口按角色缓存，sync 路径里两个 mode 各自触发自己的增长。

**练习 3**：为什么说「本 rank 份额也走窗口」让 copy-out 变成一次平坦拷贝？

**答案**：所有发送方（包括本 rank 自己）都把数据写进窗口的稠密前缀，窗口内容从基址起就是完整的输出张量字节。copy-out 因此不需要任何重排，只需把整段字节从窗口搬进调用者的输出张量——一次 `cudaMemcpyAsync`。若自己的份额直接留在输入里，copy-out 就得处理「一部分在窗口、一部分在本地」的拼接。

### 4.4 validate 与溢出防护：先于一切分配的防御

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

`build_plan` 的开头是三道闸门：`dims.validate()`、`elem_size` 检查、`mode` 检查（[src/a2a_plan.cc:L143-L151](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L143-L151)）。纪律是：**校验必须先于任何分配**（头文件注释：Call before anything allocates）。这与 u2-l2 讲过的「全部校验先于第一个屏障」一脉相承——被拒的参数不该留下任何副作用。

溢出防护是本模块的主角。要害在于：上层入口 `make_dims`（src/group.cc，u2-l3 讲过）只拿**本 rank 的张量**和 splits 交叉校验，**peer 的表项不受任何张量约束**。如果 `seq_splits = [1, 2^62]`，`window_numel` 的乘积会溢出 int64——注释原话：**一个回绕的乘积给出负的 window_numel，而每个下游尺寸检查都会把它读成「够小」**。防护分三层：

1. `checked_mul(a, b)`：乘之前检查 \( b > \lfloor \text{max}/a \rfloor \)。
2. `checked_sum(values)`：累加时检查运行和。
3. `check_byte_products`：给**所有字节量**（offset、pitch、width、slice 都是五个因子的部分乘积）一个总上界——因为 window_numel 按元素计，管不住按字节计的量；而有符号溢出是 UB，连「变成负数被下游抓住」都不可指望。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```
validate():
  world_size > 0
  0 <= rank < world_size
  b > 0 且 d > 0
  len(seq_splits)  == world_size
  len(head_splits) == world_size
  每个表项 >= 0      （== 0 合法：零分片；< 0 拒绝）
  任一失败 -> throw std::invalid_argument("fast_ulysses: <指名字段的问题>")

checked_mul(a, b):
  若 a != 0 且 b > INT64_MAX / a -> fail（"overflows int64"）
  否则返回 a * b

check_byte_products(dims, seq_total, head_total, elem_size):
  bound = ∏ max(factor, 1)  for factor in {b, seq_total, head_total, d, elem_size}
  每步乘法走 checked_mul          （空轴按 1 计：它只是让拷贝不发射，不会让别的因子变小）
```

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`validate` 为什么允许 `seq_splits` 里出现 0，却不允许负数？

**答案**：0 是真实会发生的几何——不均分时某个 rank 可能恰好分不到序列（[test/test_plan.py:L179-L181](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/test/test_plan.py#L179-L181) 的 `test_empty_shard` 专门覆盖 `[3,0,5,4]`），此时该 rank 只是不发射拷贝；负数没有任何合法语义，且会让前缀和产生重叠区间，所以直接拒绝（[src/a2a_plan.cc:L132-L140](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L132-L140)）。

**练习 2**：`check_byte_products` 为什么把空轴按 1 计，而不是跳过？

**答案**：一个为 0 的轴（比如 `b == 0`）确实让拷贝不再发射，但它**不会让其他因子变小**——发射公式里剩下的因子（seq_total、head_total、d、elem_size）的乘积仍然会被算出来。若按 0 跳过，上界就漏掉了这些量。按 1 计让上界覆盖「即使什么都没发，中间乘积也可能溢出」的情形（[src/a2a_plan.cc:L42-L43](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L42-L43) 注释）。

**练习 3**：为什么 `checked_mul` 的条件是 `a != 0 && b > max / a`，而不是写完乘法再检查结果为负？

**答案**：两个原因。其一，有符号溢出在 C++ 里是 UB——写完再查根本不保证能观察到「负数」，编译器可以假设溢出不发生而删掉检查。其二，正溢出的结果未必是负数（可能回绕成小正数），事后检查连「恰好变小的窗口」都抓不住。事前用整数除法比较是唯一可靠的做法；`a != 0` 守卫避免除零（[src/a2a_plan.cc:L19-L25](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L19-L25)）。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
